## Description

An unbranched filament of cylindrical cells 5–10 µm wide and 0.5–3 times as long as wide, each with a
parietal band chloroplast covering half the wall and a pyrenoid.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [filament](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#filaments) of 10 cells of 12 × 8 µm with the `axial_plate`
style.
